about.takweyat_international_organization_is_a: Takweyat International Organization (تقویت) is a dynamic collective of civil society members originating from diverse professional backgrounds. We are lawyers, doctors, educators, and social workers who believe that true societal strength comes from active, on-ground participation rather than passive observation. Grounded in core Islamic values of justice, ethical responsibility, and brotherhood, we pool our own professional expertise and time to intervene where society needs it most. Whether it is providing pro-bono legal defense, setting up medical camps, or executing disaster relief, Takweyat is driven purely by the power of human capital and community dedication.
about.our_structure_the_power_of_civil: Our Structure: The Power of Civil Society
about.we_are_not_a_traditional_charity: We are not a traditional charity; we are a multidisciplinary movement. Our main organizational body is composed of respected members of civil society who volunteer their specialized skills to create systemic, long-term change. By uniting different professions under one banner, we ensure that every challenge—from human rights violations to climate disasters—is met with expert, actionable solutions.
about.throughout_my_career_in_the_legal: “Throughout my career in the legal field, I have witnessed the devastating impact of systemic neglect. I also realized that the solution lies within us—the professionals and active members of civil society. Takweyat (تقویت) was born from the realization that we cannot wait for others to fix our society. We do not ask for your funds; we ask for your expertise. From fighting human rights violations in the courtroom to delivering medical aid on the streets, our commitment is fueled by the personal dedication of our members. I invite professionals from all walks of life to join us in this mission of empathy, justice, and actionable change.”

Pages are built with clear headings, a skip link, visible keyboard focus, readable text sizes and strong colour contrast, and they adapt to phones and tablets. Animation is reduced or removed for visitors whose devices ask for reduced motion.

free-legal-aid.at_takweyat_we_believe_that_a: At Takweyat (تقویت), we believe that a fair trial and legal protection are constitutional rights that should never be denied due to poverty or social status. Led by experienced legal professionals and criminal defense advocates, our Legal Aid Network provides absolute pro-bono (free of charge) legal counseling and court representation to the marginalized, the oppressed, and the voiceless. If you are facing gross injustice, unlawful harassment, or a violation of your basic human rights, our coalition of volunteer lawyers stands ready to defend you.
free-legal-aid.we_do_not_accept_commercial_corporate: We do not accept commercial, corporate, or property/land disputes unless they involve the direct exploitation of a highly vulnerable individual.

privacy.when_you_send_us_a_form: When you send us a form or an email, we ask for the details needed to respond: your name, a way to reach you, and what you want to tell us.
